<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5>At the water's bottom of <COL FEEB4EFF>Kikatako Ice Cliff</COL>,
I saw coral moving.

<MWT 4>That coral dragged <COL FEEB4EFF>a Jaggi</COL> drinking water
down to the water's bottom in the <COL FEEB4EFF>night</COL>.

<MWT 4>What on earth was that?
A coral that hunts Jaggi chills me.
